boundary: Automatic external CT Psoas source-mask component geometry only. RAS+ centroid ordering and voxel occupancy do not establish named muscle identity, clinical segmentation accuracy, physical volume, Numi subject binding, or mechanics.

method.component_centroids: occupied voxel-centre means transformed through each scan's NIfTI affine
method.component_order: components are ranked by RAS+ X for reporting; this does not confer named muscle or clinical laterality
method.occupancy: source label voxel count multiplied by affine determinant, expressed in mL

source.coordinate_convention: NIfTI RAS+ in millimetres; source scans retain independent voxel-to-world affines
